summary.text: Enslavement path dao marks are law traces of enslavement path. Dense marks in an immortal aperture ease control and breeding of living beings; on a body they can brand slaves, aid refinement of enslavement Immortal Gu, and appear innately on some races and beasts.

claims.text: Hu Immortal blessed land is most abundant in enslavement path dao marks. Those marks help raise foxes, enslave beast groups similar in body structure to foxes, and promote the growth of desolate beasts.

After the swamp crab earthly calamity the blessed land gained large amounts of enslavement path dao marks: the higher those marks, the easier it is to control raised living beings and the higher their reproduction, covering rockmen, hairy men, fox groups, wolf groups, fish groups, and more. Because Hu Immortal was an enslavement path Gu Immortal, tribulations add enslavement path dao marks in the highest quantity.
General dao marks and attainment levels are covered on dao marks and attainment.

While alive, Hu Immortal’s body held only enslavement path dao marks even though her blessed land also held earth path, space path, and time path dao marks. After she died, the enslavement path dao marks on her body all transferred into her blessed land.

As an enslavement path blessed land with a larger number of enslavement path dao marks, Hu Immortal blessed land lets Fang Yuan manage hairy man slaves more easily. Moved to Star Form blessed land, those hairy men would not be as obedient or refine Gu as enthusiastically.

Twelfth Hair raised a failed-refinement Gu embryo to rank six Immortal Slave, which can add enslavement path dao marks to his body. Lang Ya land spirit valued those marks because they provide huge help when refining enslavement path Immortal Gu.

Heavenly Lord Bai Zu’s shadowless horse carries many enslavement path dao marks besides dark path and light path dao marks. Fang Yuan cannot remove those enslavement marks, so he kills the horse rather than keep a branded slave that would wreck his aperture.
An ancient desolate beast queen toad has a lot of enslavement path dao marks and can command huge toads at rank six and below.

Mount Snail’s body is full of enslavement path and earth path dao marks, spawning matching resources around it, and the snail itself is hard even for rank eight enslavement path Gu Immortals to control because it is full of enslavement path dao marks.

Dragonmen possess enslavement path dao marks from birth and have incomparable talent in enslavement path, ruling other lifeforms more easily than other races. Fang Yuan deduces that those marks also tighten dragonman society from within, an internal effect he judges more significant than their external influence.
